claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: G-15 is a GPER1 antagonist with no documented cytotoxic off-target at 2.5 uM, and the retrieved abstracts provide no evidence of a killing mechanism, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
